# Comfy Seedance 1.0 Pro- Image to Video

Transform static images into dynamic videos using ByteDance's Seedance model. Analyzes image structure and generates natural motion with consistent visual style and coherent video sequences. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bytedance_image_to_video.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
